_comment: WC2026 ROUND OF 16 (bracket tie 95: winner of Argentina-Cape Verde vs winner of Australia-Egypt). KNOCKOUT: no draw -- level after 90' -> extra time -> penalties, so the deliverable is who ADVANCES. Winner goes to QF100 to meet the Switzerland-Colombia winner (tie 96) in the quarter-finals. Routes: Argentina WON Group J with a PERFECT nine (3-0 Algeria, 2-0 Austria, 3-1 Jordan; 9 pts, GF 8 GA 1, rating 95) -- tournament top-tier -- then survived a scare, beating Cape Verde 3-2 in EXTRA TIME (1-1 at 90') in the R16... no, in the R32; the proven block took them deep. Egypt came through Group G (1-1 Belgium, 3-1 New Zealand, 1-1 Iran; 5 pts, GF 5 GA 3, rating 74) -- organized, HELD Belgium 1-1 -- then ELIMINATED Australia on penalties (1-1) in the R32; a disciplined, tournament-tough grinder with a modest attack (GF 5, 3 vs NZ). Class gap is ENORMOUS (~21, 95 vs 74) -> Argentina a heavy favourite; the 'elite favourite vs organized defensive underdog' archetype (like Argentina-Cape Verde, but Egypt is a bit stronger and more of a genuine side than a pure minnow block). FULL FRAMEWORK APPLIED: (1) DON'T FADE THE ELITE -- first pass sat 3.5 pts below the market on Argentina (71.1 vs 74.6); lifted ARG 2.20 -> 2.35 to align (74.1 vs 74.6, div 0.5). (2) BTTS RULE -- Egypt has a MODEST attack (not an elite striker) -> trimmed Egypt's lambda (0.68) -> BTTS-No 54.7%, Argentina clean sheet 50.7%. (3) ARGENTINA-CAPE VERDE REFINEMENT -- Egypt is a PROVEN grinder (held Belgium 1-1, beat Australia on penalties), so keep the draw/ET tail HONEST (ET 17.5%, pens 7.7%) and do NOT zero their attack (Egypt lambda 0.68 keeps BTTS 45%, not ~0). Argentina should WIN, likely a controlled-to-comfortable margin (1-0/2-0/3-0), Egypt rarely scores; but Egypt's grind + penalty pedigree gives a modest, real deep/ET tail (Cape Verde already took Argentina to ET once). Home = Argentina (nominal; neutral venue). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).
